The companies plan to develop K-Fashion and apparel-focused large language and multimodal AI models for Korean and global markets.
XMax AI will contribute its AI infrastructure and model-deployment capabilities, while apM Group will provide fashion expertise, datasets and its commercial ecosystem.
The companies are also exploring a Korea-based AI joint venture covering infrastructure, model development, commercialization and AI application deployment.
The cooperation is intended to expand XMax AI from general-purpose model API services into vertical, industry-specific AI solutions.
